classes.desc: INNER / LEFT / RIGHT / FULL / CROSS (OUTER) JOIN
ON and USING, AND / OR inside ON
several JOINs and comma-separated FROM tables
JOIN to a subquery or a CTE
tokenizer: JOIN phrases merge into one token; LEFT / RIGHT functions stay identifiers

cases.name: any JOIN type with ON, multi-word LEFT OUTER JOIN
cases.sql: select * from users u left outer join orders o on o.user_id = u.id

cases.name: JOIN without ON or USING
cases.sql: select * from sizes s cross join colors c

cases.name: USING instead of ON
cases.sql: select * from users u join orders o using (user_id)

cases.name: comma-joined tables one per line
cases.sql: select * from users u, orders o where o.user_id = u.id

cases.name: comma-joined table after JOIN goes under FROM
cases.sql: select * from t join b on a.id=b.id, c

cases.name: only listed JOIN phrases merge, an alias named left stays
cases.sql: select * from t left left join b on t.id = b.id

cases.name: ON with AND
cases.sql: select * from users u join orders o on o.user_id = u.id and o.status = 'paid'

cases.name: ON with AND and OR group
cases.sql: select * from users u join orders o on o.user_id = u.id and (o.status = 'paid' or o.status = 'shipped')

cases.name: ON with BETWEEN
cases.sql: select * from events e join periods p on e.ts between p.start_ts and p.end_ts
format_want: ON e.ts BETWEEN p.start_ts AND p.end_ts

cases.name: ON with AND then WHERE with AND
cases.sql: select * from users u join orders o on o.user_id = u.id and o.amount > 0 where u.active = 1 and o.status = 'paid'

cases.name: three tables
cases.sql: select u.id, p.amount from users u join orders o on o.user_id = u.id left join payments p on p.order_id = o.id

cases.name: self join
cases.sql: select e.first_name, m.first_name as manager from employees e left join employees m on m.id = e.manager_id

cases.name: all clauses
cases.sql: select u.country, count(*) as n from users u join orders o on o.user_id = u.id where o.amount > 10 group by u.country having count(*) > 5 order by n desc limit 3

cases.name: input whitespace and line breaks are ignored
cases.sql:
SELECT u.id, o.amount
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.active = 1

cases.name: JOIN a derived table
cases.sql: select u.id, t.total from users u join (select user_id, sum(amount) as total from orders group by user_id) t on t.user_id = u.id

cases.name: JOIN inside a subquery
cases.sql: select * from users where id in (select o.user_id from orders o join payments p on p.order_id = o.id)

cases.name: JOIN a CTE
cases.sql: with paid as (select order_id from payments where status = 'ok') select o.id from orders o join paid p on p.order_id = o.id

cases.name: JOIN alone
cases.sql: join t on a = b

cases.name: JOIN types are one token each
cases.sql: inner join a left join b right join c full join d cross join e

cases.name: OUTER JOIN types are one token each
cases.sql: Left Outer Join a full outer join b

cases.name: JOIN type across a newline
cases.sql:
left
  join a

cases.name: only listed JOIN phrases merge
cases.sql: left outer inner join a left left join b

cases.name: USING
cases.sql: join t using (id)

cases.name: LEFT and RIGHT functions stay identifiers
cases.sql: left(email, 3) right(email, 2)
